title: Spoke & Sprocket
brief: Spoke & Sprocket is our bike repair workshop and refurbished bike shop in Utrecht, run by me (Joris) and my sister Femke. We fix city bikes, cargo bikes and e-bikes (all brands for the bike part; we can't service e-bike motors, only the bike around them). We also sell refurbished second-hand city bikes, every one checked, with a three-month workshop guarantee. Opening hours: Tuesday to Friday 9:00 to 18:00, Saturday 10:00 to 16:00, closed Sunday and Monday. Repairs are walk-in for flat tyres; everything else needs a booking. Please show our repair prices as placeholders, we're changing them. The bikes for sale change every week, so show a few example listings that are clearly marked as examples, not real stock. The repair booking form isn't connected yet, so it can't say the booking is confirmed. Email werkplaats@spokeandsprocket.example. Address to confirm. Write it in English, with a short Dutch line on the home page. No fake reviews, no star ratings and no "best in Utrecht".
